RQ1 question-only retrieval-benefit sign.answer: YES, weak ranking signal; no useful Pareto policy emerged
RQ1 question-only retrieval-benefit sign.evidence: positive prevalence=0.0558; TF-IDF PR-AUC=0.0690; BGE PR-AUC=0.0624; best learned OOF accuracy=0.6204 vs closed=0.6199

RQ2 semantic BGE vs lexical TF-IDF.answer: NO / mixed; BGE does not beat TF-IDF on both PR-AUC and hierarchical accuracy
RQ2 semantic BGE vs lexical TF-IDF.evidence: BGE vs TF-IDF Stage-1 PR-AUC 0.0624 vs 0.0690; hierarchical OOF accuracy 0.6187 vs 0.6180. No confirmatory significance test is claimed.

RQ3 value of Stage 2 retriever selector.evidence: BGE hierarchical accuracy=0.6187, always-MedCPT=0.6199; rescue-only selector accuracy=0.5582, macro-F1=0.5233, majority-BM25 baseline accuracy=0.6712

RQ4 Pareto-domination of Cheap.evidence: frontier=['closed_book', 'cost_oracle_v2', 'tfidf_direct']; best learned=tfidf_direct accuracy=0.6204, retrieval rate=0.0206; cheap accuracy=0.6223, retrieval rate=0.4415

RQ5 recovery of oracle headroom.evidence: Closed=0.6199; best fixed=0.6245; Cheap=0.6223; best learned=0.6204; Oracle v2=0.6756; relative-to-Cheap-to-Oracle fraction=-3.6%
